assumptions.choice: Treat 1m OHLCV data bars directly as streaming ticks, evaluating signals on bar close price and volume.
assumptions.reason: The execution environment provides 1m bar data rather than tick-by-tick streaming data.

assumptions.choice: Filter entry signals when timestamp time is prior to 09:35:00 EST.
assumptions.reason: The session open is at 09:30:00 EST, so the first 5 minutes span 09:30:00 through 09:34:59.

assumptions.choice: Track up to 3 scale-in position entries on the single data feed and use the aggregated average position price (self.position.price) for stop-loss/take-profit.
assumptions.reason: Backtrader aggregates orders on a single feed into one net position while the spec permits up to 3 simultaneously open positions.
